scope: Combat damage display receive path from clientbound battle-result packets into the internal visual result queue.

conclusion.summary: The receive-side amount/effect path for damage popups is the battle-result packet family, not a SetActorProperty property-id branch in the current evidence slice. The third router dispatches 0x0139, 0x013A, 0x013B, and 0x013C into battle-result stagers. The decoded and pcap-backed carriers are 0x0139 CommandResultX01, 0x013A CommandResultX10/BattleActionX10, and 0x013C CommandResultX00.
conclusion.stateMutationBoundary: SetActorProperty 0x0137 remains the main actor-state mutation path. Damage amount, worldMasterTextId, effectId, param, and hitNum for visual feedback are carried by the CommandResult/BattleAction records decoded here.
conclusion.downstreamBoundary: This path reaches the internal 0x1A0 battle-result queue, resolves the effect-id visual selector mapping, and identifies the concrete Vfx/Rapture consumer boundary (BCS-Y-0425 -> BCS-Y-0420). The later indirect call is now resolved to the target CharaActor's RaptureSchEffectController; its runtime schedule-target lookup is not a per-selector Rapture*Clip class dispatch.

opcodeBindings.name: CommandResultX18Packet / BattleActionX18Packet
opcodeBindings.note: The 18-row sparse-SoA layout is statically decoded by FUN_005874B0 and summarized in manifests/battle_result_field_semantics.json. No 0x013B occurrence exists in the retained capture corpus, so runtime values and the CommandResultX18/BattleActionX18 name discriminator remain unresolved.

functionTrace.role: Third-router switch routes battle-result opcodes 0x0139..0x013C to shape-specific wrappers.
Shape-specific wrappers allocate a 0x1A0 local staging entry, call the effect visual selector, call the matching stager, then enqueue.
Effect-id visual class selector maps effect/animation categories to compact selectors used by the staged entry.
Stagers copy the common header and either zero, one, or up to ten target rows into BCS-S-0031.
Queue push and queue-entry copy confirm a 0x1A0 internal record copied into a ring buffer for downstream action/visual processing.
